source: 2025-2028 Southeastern Alaska/Yakutat Areas Commercial Salmon Fishing Regulations
extraction_note: The ADF&G booklet PDF could not be read past Chapter 30 (Yakutat) through the available fetch channel - Chapter 33 was truncated and returned NOT FOUND on repeated attempts, and direct download of the PDF is blocked by this environment's egress policy. The regulation text below was therefore taken from the Cornell LII published text of 5 AAC 33.200 (the same Alaska Administrative Code section the booklet reprints), whose amendment history runs through am 7/28/2023, Register 247, October 2023. Every coordinate was extracted three independent times using differently-worded prompts (chunked verbatim transcription, one-token-per-line enumeration, comma-split fragment listing) and only values identical across passes were recorded. Verbatim 'text' fields are reconstructed from consecutive <=100-character verbatim chunks and confirmed against a comma-split pass; the degree symbol was normalized to U+00B0 where the upstream rendering intermittently emitted a double-quote character.
notation: degrees and decimal minutes, e.g. "55° 46.87' N. lat." / "133° 42.10' W. long." — NOT degrees-minutes-seconds; minutes are printed to two decimal places; recorded as printed, unconverted
